## Change

Describe the behavior and link the issue, if any.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the change and pass locally/CI.
- [ ] No credentials, signing files, personal data, or private logs are included.
- [ ] Dependency/native/workflow changes and their provenance are explained.
- [ ] Privacy, permissions, exports, and third-party notices remain accurate.
- [ ] For a release to `main`: all versions match, Android version codes increase and are unused in Play.

Report vulnerabilities privately through SECURITY.md, not in this PR.
